title: RNA-seq of human mesenchymal stem cells cultured on collagenase material against tissue culture plastic controls
description: Human adipose and bone marrow-derived mesenchymal stem cells were cultured either on collagenase biomaterial (CardioCel®) or normal tissue culture plastic over 48 hours in standard culture conditions, in serum-free medium.

samples.title: Sample 1
samples.description: Protocols: After incubation, cells were rinsed in PBS twice before being lysed directly in Buffer RLT Plus from the RNeasy plus micro kit (Qiagen, Victoria, Australia). Cells were cultured in a humidified incubator at 37ºC, with 5% carbon dioxide. Growth medium provided contains 1 g/L D-glucose (Gibco, Victoria, Australia) Dulbecco’s Modified Eagle Medium (DMEM), L-Glutamine and 110 mg/L Sodium pyruvate, supplemented with 10% foetal bovine serum (Bovogen, Victoria, Australia) and 1% Penicillin-Streptomycin (Gibco, Victoria, Australia) Cells were cultured on either collagen biomaterial or tissue culture plastic at 1,000,000 cells per sample collection over 48 hours in growth medium. Total RNA was extracted from lysed cells using the RNeasy Plus Micro kit (Qiagen, Victoria, Australia). Quality of RNA was determined on the 2100 BioAnalyzer (Agilent Technologies, Victoria, Australia). All samples of at least an RNA Integrity Number (RIN) of ≥ 8.0 and an A260/280 ratio of 1.8 – 2.0 were accepted. Library preparation was performed on 1 µg total RNA per sample with the Illumina TruSeq® Stranded mRNA kit according to manufacturer’s protocol (Illumina, San Diego, California).
attributes: adipose tissue derived mesenchymal stem cell

runs.experiment_title: Illumina HiSeq 2500 sequencing: RNA-seq of human mesenchymal stem cells cultured on collagenase material against tissue culture plastic controls
